title: Single borrow transition
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be a valid input-head position, and let $\mathrm{out}$ and $\mathrm{pre}$ be Boolean words. If the borrow-phase machine has its work head at cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$ and its tape contains $\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{bs}$, one step leaves the input position and output unchanged and acts as follows. If $\mathrm{bs}$ is empty, it enters the borrow-result state with failure and moves the work head to $|\mathrm{pre}|-1$, leaving the tape unchanged. If $\mathrm{bs}$ begins with $1$, it enters the borrow-result state with success, changes that bit to $0$, and moves the head to $|\mathrm{pre}|-1$. If $\mathrm{bs}$ begins with $0$, it remains in the borrow state, changes that bit to $1$, and moves the head to $|\mathrm{pre}|+1$. No output is emitted in any case.
replaced: For every emitted prefix, every input and position, and every counter word split as $p\,s$: one step of the countdown emitter in the borrow state with work head at cell $|p|$ clears a leading $1$ of $s$ and turns to rewind with success, converts a leading $0$ of $s$ to $1$ and advances, or, at the blank end of the word, turns to rewind with failure; in each case the width is preserved and nothing is emitted.
